actor: Independent AI reviewer; Root performed the native UI actions. This reviewer only read evidence and used view_image.
method: Original-resolution view_image inspection of seven native screenshots, plus associated public SVG/JSON revision readback. This is a static pixel review, not presented-FPS evidence.

findings.result: The collapsed ResidualCNN overview is orderly: aligned cards, separated stem fan-out lanes and vertical routes, no visually apparent unrelated-edge crossing or gratuitous bend. The blocks card remains collapsed; this image cannot certify expanded residual internals. At 58% zoom the subtitles, legend text and arrowheads are very small and low-contrast, although primary node names remain recognizable.

The expanded MLP is readable at 97% with clear names and vertical main-chain arrows. The full paper is taller than the viewport and its lower content is clipped by the workspace viewport. The features-to-network-to-first-child boundary routing uses an exterior side lane and return at the network header; this has more bends than the simple chain but is associated with the explicit container representation.

Right move remains orderly and separated. The first child is visibly offset; its outgoing connector has a small necessary dogleg back to the centered next card. No additional unrelated crossing is visually apparent.

The selected first child extends left of its network container. The visible warning correctly says it exceeds the network boundary; the outgoing dogleg remains identifiable. This state does not qualify as a clean layout.

The selected first child intrudes into the network header, obscuring part of its title area and crowding the incoming arrows. The visible warning mentions both header intrusion and a blocked connection. This state does not qualify as a clean layout.

The selected first child touches/overlaps the GELU card. The arrow port area is crowded and the right detour forms an unattractive local rectangular loop; the visible warning reports overlap and a blocked connection. This is an unresolved visual warning state, not an all-directions-aesthetic pass.

The full paper fits at 58% zoom without visible clipping; primary labels remain distinguishable. Subtitles, legend text and arrows are too small for confident detailed novice reading at native screenshot scale. The ordinary vertical chain and two boundary transitions remain visually traceable.

freshness.inspectedNativeRevisions: The native up/down/left/right screenshot footer revisions agree with JSON/SVG revisions 16/18/14/12 and coordinate fields; no stale mismatch was observed among these selected captures.
freshness.excludedAmbiguousAttempts: Existing 02-mlp-right and 03-mlp-right-undo are retained as failed/stale attempts according to the prior independent report. They were not used to establish successful movement here.
freshness.zoomCaptureLimit: 11-mlp-zoom-fit has a DOM snapshot and screenshot but no matching .json or .svg file; its pixels alone cannot bind all scene facts.
freshness.publicationLimit: A display of 180mm paper inside an editor is not a physical publication-size review.

limits: AI review cannot count as a real researcher or human publication reviewer.
Static screenshots do not independently prove gestures, intermediate preview/paint behavior, undo, exports or performance.
No product or previous report was changed by this review.
